page: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-16 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine within the G2 family, tailored for graphics rendering and AI inference. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon processor operating at 2.2 GHz, delivering 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. It provides 64 GB of system RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA L4 GPU from the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached persistent disks for file and operating system storage.

Benchmark results highlight strong specialized performance in machine learning inference. In small (135M) language model tests, the system achieved top-tier throughput of 11,777.6 tokens per second for prompt processing and 394.94 tokens per second for text generation. For medium-sized (7B) language models, it maintained top-tier generation rates of 52.08 tokens per second and prompt ingestion of 2,199.18 tokens per second. Performance drops significantly on 70B models due to the 24 GB VRAM boundary, achieving 14.01 tokens per second during prompt ingestion without viable standalone generation throughput.

General-purpose CPU metrics reflect typical mid-tier virtualization results. The CPU registered a PassMark score of 13,537.93 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 6,659.0, while single-threaded tasks yielded bottom-quartile results such as a Geekbench single-core score of 1,063.0. Memory bandwidth reached 87.33 GB/sec on uncached large reads and 46.35 GB/sec on writes, supporting 12.16 million Redis SET operations per second.

The g2-standard-16 provides high cost efficiency for small to mid-scale deep learning inference pipelines and GPU-driven graphics workloads that do not demand multi-GPU configurations. The host is best suited for real-time model serving up to 7B parameters, video transcoding, visual computing, and general-purpose GPU workloads.
description: Google Cloud Platform g2-standard-16 is a GPU-accelerated instance designed for AI inference and graphics processing. The server features 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical Intel Xeon cores at 2.2 GHz, paired with 64 GB of system RAM and a single NVIDIA L4 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. It includes no local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage volumes. In synthetic and practical benchmarks, the L4 GPU demonstrates top-tier efficiency for small and medium language model inference, achieving over 52 tokens per second on 7B models and rapid prompt processing. CPU throughput ranks in the middle tier for multi-core workloads, while single-thread execution is modest. The g2-standard-16 represents a balanced, cost-effective platform for running medium parameter inference, cloud rendering, and media processing pipelines.
